title: MyBrainSpec

summary.en: A short cognitive self-check. AI scores it and returns a written profile of how your own attention and memory actually behave.
summary.jp: 短い自己診断に答える。AIが注意力と記憶の傾向を採点し、文章のプロフィールにして返す。

thesis.en: A short, structured self-check can surface genuine patterns in a person's own attention and memory — worth reflecting back as a written profile.
thesis.jp: 短く構造化した自己診断でも、注意力や記憶の本当の傾向は見えてくる。文章にして返す価値がある。

experiment.en: Built a short cognitive self-check app in React/Vite with Firebase; Gemini scores responses and returns a written profile of the user's attention and memory.
experiment.jp: React/Vite と Firebase で自己診断アプリを構築。Geminiが回答を採点し、文章のプロフィールを返す。

question.en: Can a short self-administered check produce a genuinely useful, personalized profile of how someone's attention and memory actually behave?
question.jp: 短い自己診断だけで、注意力と記憶の本当の傾向を映す、役に立つ個人向けの診断ができるか。

mine: Designed a short cognitive self-check covering attention and memory
Built the AI scoring and written-profile generation with Gemini
Built the app in React/Vite with Firebase
